subject: Clarify EU transfer mitigations and subprocessor evidence for DPIA
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medicaresolutions.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal.ops@medicaresolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: DPIA evidence needed for EU transfer review

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — MS will be moving into a formal DPIA for the new clinical ingestion pipeline and our privacy team has flagged a few items they need from Redwood to close the transfer risk chapter:

- Full subprocessor inventory (including processing purpose, data categories, hosting location by country)
- Export of Article 30 processing records relevant to our integration (sample is fine)
- KMS/crypto control evidence (key management provider, rotation policies, attestations)
- Any documented transfer mitigations (SCCs, onshore hosting options, technical controls)

Can you confirm whether you can provide the artifacts above by 2028-03-10? If not, please propose the earliest feasible date.

Appreciate it — Emily

--
Emily Zhao
Privacy Counsel, MedicareSolutions
emily.zhao@medicaresolutions.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medicaresolutions.com>, Legal Ops <legal.ops@medicaresolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence needed for EU transfer review

Thanks Emily — looping in our privacy and operations leads to scope this. Internal team, quick ask: can we assemble a deliverable pack that covers Emily's bullets? Specific items to collect:

1) Subprocessor export: name, hashed environment id, processing purpose, data categories, hosting country, contract start date. CSV is fine; remove any service account secrets.
2) Article 30 export: excerpt for the service relevant to MS (processors list + activities).
3) KMS evidence: KMS provider, key rotation cadence, who holds KEKs, HSM usage notes, and any audit snippets we can share.
4) Transfer mitigations: copy of the DPA (Art 28/29/30 clauses), SCC matrix (if used), and notes on onshore hosting options or regions where data can be processed within EU.

Marissa — can you pull the subprocessor CSV and a short network diagram? Ben — can you confirm whether the DPA language for Art 28 covers the additional logging/inspection MS asks for or if we need a narrow addendum? Jonas — operationally, can we provide a short statement on prefix/KV caching and whether any EU data might be egressed to non-EU GPUs during inference?

If we can produce a draft pack by EOD 3/2, I'll send that to Emily with a proposed follow-up call for 3/6.

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Head of Security & Privacy Partnerships
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medicaresolutions.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence needed for EU transfer review

Attaching initial artifacts and a couple of clarifying notes. Quick notes inline below the requested list.

Attachments: subprocessors_export_20280301.csv; kms_control_snippet_20280302.pdf; network-boundary-diagram_v3.png

- Subprocessor CSV: includes vendor, purpose, country. I redacted cloud account ids per our policy. Let me know if MS needs more granularity on sub-subprocessors.
- Article 30: we don't auto-generate a full Article 30 ledger per customer; I exported the relevant rows for the service.
- KMS controls: included a redacted snippet from our last key rotation audit and the provider name. We can provide an HSM attestation under NDA if needed.
- Transfers/mitigations: we currently rely on SCCs + contractual DPA; Dedicated EU-only hosting is available in specific regions (we can provide a contract addendum for residency).

Questions for Ben: MS asked about additional inspection/logging in Art 28 — do we allow customer-side log access beyond token-level traces? If not, can we offer a contractual SOC2 evidence-sharing clause instead?

Propose: send the attached pack to Emily and offer a 30-min sync next week. If they insist on an Article 28/30 living ledger export, ops will need a minor script update (ETA 3 business days).

Thanks — attaching files here (stubs).

--
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medicaresolutions.com>, Legal Ops <legal.ops@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPIA evidence needed for EU transfer review

Nice work assembling these quickly. Plan & proposed reply to send to Emily (ready to paste):

--- suggested customer reply ---
Hi Emily,

Thanks — please find an initial DPIA evidence pack attached (subprocessor list, Article 30 excerpt, KMS control snippet, network boundary diagram). A few clarifications:

• Subprocessors: attached CSV lists current subprocessors, processing purposes and hosting country. We can provide more granular asset IDs on NDA.
• Article 30: excerpt exported for the Redwood service used in your integration.
• Crypto controls: our KMS provider is listed; rotation policies and an audit snippet are included. HSM attestation available under NDA.
• Transfers: Redwood supports SCCs and can offer EU-dedicated hosting in qualified regions; we can add a residency addendum if required.

If that looks reasonable, we'd propose a 30-minute call next week (we have 3/6 or 3/7 available) to walk through the evidence and note any follow-ups for the DPIA.

Best,
Soojin, Jonas and team
--- end suggested reply ---

Operational notes: ops confirms no non-EU egress for resident jobs pinned to EU Dedicated; for hosted API there is potential cross-region GPU routing if a customer does not pin region (we'll highlight that in the reply). Legal, Ben: please sign off on the phrasing around SCCs and residency addendum.

If everyone approves, I'll send to Emily now with the three attachments Marissa provided.

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
VP, Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference
